messages:
sam: Planning note: I'll start a bulk rename of docs under `/guides/` into `/how-to/` tomorrow. This will touch ~12 pages and a few anchors. Want to confirm QA and merge order before I open PRs.

lee: Bulk renames are scary. Proposal: do redirect-only PRs first, then small content moves one at a time. Also add a sitemap patch so search crawlers update gradually.

isabel: Agree on redirects first. Also can we run an automated anchor-preserve script that adds explicit anchors where necessary? I can whip one up that parses headings and inserts `<a id=...>` shims.

rahul: If we're adding explicit anchors via a script, let's commit them in a separate PR (anchor-shims) that can be merged before content moves. That way redirects + shims = stable old anchors.

paula: Reviewers: I can take the first 4 renames and cross-link updates. Sam, can you tag me in PR bodies with a list of dependent pages?

sam: Yes. Plan I'm thinking: (1) PR A - redirects only (status 301) (2) PR B - anchor-shims only (3) PR C...N - individual content moves (one per page) with `docs/move` label and smoke checks.

deploy-bot: Preview created for PR A: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/1918304570  200 OK

lee: For smoke checks, let's do two things: curl preview page and grep for the old anchor id, and run a site-link-checker to flag external 404s. Keep failures as blocking for merge.

isabel: I'll add a GitHub Actions workflow `docs/smoke-anchor-check` that accepts a preview URL and a list of anchors to verify. It will post results as a comment.

paula: Also add an e2e step to run a quick devx snippet build so embedded SDK examples still compile after moves. I've seen examples break when includes move.

sam: Good call. I'll also include a step to run a repo-wide grep for old slugs to identify code references we need to update in parallel repos.

rahul: One more: label the first content-move with `canary` so infra team can monitor traffic to those pages for 30m post-merge. We'll delay auto-prod for 10m to allow manual rollback. Ops OK?

deploy-bot: Auto-prod hold applied: 10 minutes on merges with label `canary`.

paula: Can we batch small ones together? E.g., small guide pages where nobody links externally could be moved in a single PR to reduce toil. But keep larger ones separate.

lee: Yes, batch tiny pages (<200 words) in single PRs, but keep ones with anchors or external references separate. Add `size` metadata in PR body.

isabel: Script detail: it will scan headings and add anchors only where there's a mismatch between old and new slugs or when a heading text changes. It won't touch headings that already have explicit anchors. I'll open it as PR 1918304588-shim-script.

sam: I've opened PR A (1918304570-guides-redirects) and PR shim (1918304588-anchor-shims). Assigning reviewers @paula and @lee.

docs-bot: Previews: PR 1918304570 at https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/1918304570, PR 1918304588 at https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/1918304588

paula: Quick look: redirect rules look good. The preview shows 301 header and the HTML at the target page has the shim anchor for `getting-started-auth` present. :white_check_mark:

lee: I've queued the smoke-check for the redirect PR. Results will post as a comment.

docs-bot: Smoke anchor check passed on PR 1918304570.

isabel: Anchor shim PR looks fine. One question: the script added anchors that duplicate existing ids (rare). I cleaned duplicates and left a note in the PR.

rahul: Once both redirect and shims are merged, proceed with content-move PRs. Keep an aggressive reviewer cadence. We need two approvals for big pages.

sam: Timeline: Redirects + shims merged today. Content moves start tomorrow AM in staggered order. Will update this thread with PR numbers as I open them.

paula: Nice. Also reminder to add a migration entry under `/docs/changes/` listing moved slugs for searchers.

sam: Will do. Thanks all, will post updates as PRs open/merge.

docs-bot: Link-check scheduled for post-merge sweep: https://ci.redwood.dev/job/docs-link-scan/1918304567

lee: One last note: if the link-scan flags anchor-only failures, prefer adding shim PRs (quick fix) over revert. Reverts should be last resort.

sam: Agreed. I'll keep each PR small and include the dependent page list. OK to proceed with opens.

paula: Approved previews look green. Good to go.

rahul: Thanks team — this sequencing should avoid user-facing 404s.

sam: Merged redirects and shims. Opening move PRs now (1918304601, 1918304612...). Will ping as they go in.
